edges: Fainall overhears Mrs. Fainall discussing the plan with Foible.
Fainall accuses Mrs. Marwood of loving Mirabell.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mirabell offers to help Lady Wishfort out of an embarrassing situation if she consents to his marriage.
Mrs. Fainall tells Mirabell that she hates her husband.
Mirabell is free to marry Millamant with the full £6000 inheritance.
Mirabell and Millamant discuss the conditions under which they would accept each other in marriage.
Mirabell is informed by a footman that Waitwell and Foible were married that morning.
Sir Rowland is actually Waitwell in disguise, planning to marry Lady Wishfort.
Foible encourages Lady Wishfort to marry Sir Rowland.
Lady Wishfort wants Millamant to marry her nephew, Sir Wilfull Witwoud.
